note: Hand-curated from the troubleshooting matrix on page 13 (English section). Text extraction loses the symptom/cause dots, so this table is transcribed from the rendered page and should be reviewed by a product expert.

symptoms.label: The pump only releases a small flow of water
The motor is making a noise but will not start

rows.solution: Check the condition of connections and seals on the suction pipe
Clean the filter cap and check the condition of the rubber seal
Check the voltage on the rating plate and that of the mains
Prevent parts from causing load loss wherever possible
Remove the motor and contact the technical service

rows.cause: Increased temperature in the terminal box due to electric arc

rows.solution: Connect the cables correctly to the junction boxes
Tighten the cable correctly to the junction box / Adapt the size of the cable connection to the junction box
